name: Browser Agent — jobs from Google Sheets

nodes.name: Read credentials sheet
nodes.notes: Columns: url, task, username, password_ref (or password), enabled, session

nodes.name: Start jobs
nodes.notes: 202 + run id. Same-site jobs take turns, different sites run in parallel.

nodes.name: Wait for results
nodes.notes: httpMethod POST is required — the agent POSTs to $execution.resumeUrl. The 2h limit stops a lost callback parking the execution forever; raise it if a batch of same-host rows takes longer than that end to end.

nodes.name: Summarise run
nodes.notes: Swap for Slack / Gmail / a status column write-back.

assignments.name: error
assignments.value: ={{ $json.body?.error || ($json.body?.results || []).filter(r => !r.ok).map(r => (r.name || r.url) + ': ' + (r.error || (r.goals || []).filter(g => !g.ok).map(g => g.goal + (g.note ? ' — ' + g.note : '')).join('; ') || 'failed')).join(' | ') || 'No result — the agent never called back.' }}

nodes.name: Report failures
nodes.notes: One bad row fails the batch flag; results still lists every row.
